# Fallout 76 - Patch notes June 20, 2023 (Patch 44)

![](/uploads/ajaxGallery_177_nukaknights-post-patchnotes44.jpg)

# FALLOUT 76 THE “WHEN THE STARS ARE ALIGNED” UPDATE IS HERE!

Our latest Fallout 76 update delivers a whole host of fresh public events and gameplay improvements. Read on to find out where things are happening.

# UPDATE VERSION AND DOWNLOAD SIZE

**PC (Steam):** 1.0.0.78
**PC (Microsoft Store):** 1.0.80.0
**PlayStation:** 1.78
**Xbox:** 1.0.0.79
Here you can find out the download size of today's patch on the respective platform:

**PC (Steam):** 12.4GB
**PC (Microsoft Store):** 23.8 GB
**PlayStation:** 23.2GB
**Xbox:** 23.8GB

# UPDATE HIGHLIGHTS

## WHEN THE STARS ARE FAIR

The Blue Ridge Caravan is back and they need your help growing their business! Our When the Stars Align update includes two new Cryptids, public events, side quests, rewards, a Daily Operations mutation, and more!

### NEW PUBLIC EVENTS

Vinny Costa, operations manager for the Blue Ridge Caravan Company, is impatient with the caravan members because he believes they are not trying hard enough. Work with them to get them back on track and earn awesome Blue Ridge Caravan themed items as rewards!

#### PACK DOUSE

After a trade deal goes wrong, Luca Costa needs a little help. A group of local cultists stole his Brahmin and his load of homemade explosive devices. His Uncle Vinny won't like it when he finds out about it. Unfortunately, he is too injured to get his supplies himself!

Guided by Luca via radio, you must penetrate the cultists' hideout, plant explosives and bring back his Pack Brahmin! Be especially careful not to disturb the local wildlife - cultists have recently heard some strange noises coming from the nearby forest.

#### HEALTHY AND SAFE

Blue Ridge has developed the Midmountain Lodges into the newest and greatest Brahmin station, but can't keep the local creatures under control. The loudspeaker system designed to scare away the beasts and protect the Brahmin was damaged. To take back the station and create a safe haven for the company's own Brahmin, they need your help! Eliminate the creatures and defend the deterrent to reap a hefty reward from the Blue Ridge Caravan for your assistance.

### DAILY QUESTS “COSTA’S AFFAIRS”

Local curmudgeon and employer Vinny Costa is anything but happy with his employees' current performance, and he's only too happy to drop a few caps to get someone to take care of this problem. In this series of unique daily quests, players can learn all about the concerns and hardships of caravan workers and earn some unique rewards in the process. Unlike other daily quests, you can only complete this series of seven quests once, but each will give you a unique Blue Ridge reward, from C.A.M.P. items to outfits.

#### EXPOSE THE MYTH

Veteran players who have completed content from the extensive Fallout 76 story may find themselves faced with a special side quest that awaits them after completing all Costa's Affairs quests...

### NEW CRYPTIDS!

Cryptozoologists can rejoice! Our two new public events include the Blue Devil and the Ogua, two new cryptids based on real West Virginia folk tales.
